products.name: Yulu Dex
products.description: Grey electric bike with rear carrier, better shock absorbers, designed for gig-worker deliveries. Speed capped at 25 kmph. No licence required.

products.name: Yulu Miracle
products.description: Blue low-speed electric bike (25 kmph) aimed at individual commuters for short metro city commutes. No licence required.

products.name: Yulu Wynn
products.description: Stylish version of Miracle made by Bajaj Auto. Available for purchase at ~Rs 55,000 upfront + subscription plan (Rs 600/700/900/month).
products.status: Active (wider rollout paused as of Jul 2026)

products.name: Yulu Express
products.description: Full-sized, high-payload electric scooter (45 kmph) for e-commerce logistics, bike taxis, and express parcel delivery. Two-seater.

products.name: Yuma Energy
products.description: JV with Magna International for battery-swapping infrastructure. 300+ stations in high-demand delivery hubs. Open to other EV players.

products.name: Wrong-way ride detection
products.description: Patent-pending IoT technology that alerts riders when moving against traffic flow. Operational across 18,000 bikes in Bengaluru.
